description: UV-projection resampling of authored bitmaps (04 section 4): per user channel one fill with the 64x64 pattern (scales 1, 0.73, 1.37x2.11, rotation 30, offset 0.123/0.456) or the 256 fields A (scale 1, 3.3, sub-texel offset); filter BilinearHQ (s0), BilinearSharp (s1), Nearest (s2), BilinearHQ without repeat (s3). RGB16 channels.
